Proficient (75-89%): Logical prediction with standard independent variable
Beginner (<60%): No hypothesis declared or incorrect parameters

Exemplary (90-100%): All variables strictly audited and isolated
Proficient (75-89%): Most variables isolated with clear controls
Developing (60-74%): Only one variable controlled; weak experimental rigor

Exemplary (90-100%): Accurate plots; complete units and trend curves
Proficient (75-89%): Standard plots with units and simple axis labels
Developing (60-74%): Slight units error; trends identified loosely
Beginner (<60%): Incomplete data points plotted or inaccurate axis

Proficient (75-89%): Conclusion traces back to original hypothesis
Developing (60-74%): Weak support from recorded data; circular remarks
Beginner (<60%): No correlation drawn from trials to outcomes

Exemplary (90-100%): No conceptual errors; perfect lab procedures
Proficient (75-89%): Minor terminology errors; minor safety oversights
Beginner (<60%): Severe safety violations or key concepts majorly incorrect
